title: Aurora Spirit in Pond
description: A large, heavyset purple-skinned woman with a rounded belly stands barefoot in a dark reflective pond, her body covered in glowing white star-like dots. She is surrounded by twisted glowing tree roots, lotus flowers, two white birds in flight, and a dramatic green and pink aurora borealis in the starry night sky, with her dark shadow cast on the water.
